content.text: First episode (infants > 3 mo, 1–18 y): daily prednisone 60 mg/m2 or 2 mg/kg (max 60 mg/day) for 4 or 6 wks, then alternate-day 40 mg/m2 or 1.5 mg/kg (max 40 mg) for 4 or 6 wks; single Am dose; ⍉taper during alternate-day dosing. Steroid-sparing agents: calcineurin inhibitors, cyclophosphamide, levamisole, mycophenolate mofetil.

sources.name: IPNA clinical practice recommendations for the diagnosis and management of children with steroid-sensitive nephrotic syndrome (Pediatr Nephrol 2023;38:877-919)
